Instructions for Use
Device description: The Fjord Peripheral Stent is a peripheral stent. It is available in lengths from 15 mm to 38 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

MRI Safety Information
The Fjord Peripheral Stent is MR Conditional. A person with the Fjord Peripheral Stent may be safely scanned under the following conditions. Failure to follow these conditions may result in injury.
Parameter Condition
Device Name Fjord Peripheral Stent
Static Magnetic Field Strength (B0) 3.0 Tesla only
B0 Field Orientation Horizontal
Maximum Spatial Field Gradient 20 T/m (2,000 G/cm)
RF Receive Coil Type Any
Operating Mode Normal Operating Mode
RF Conditions Maximum Whole-Body SAR 0.1 W/kg; Maximum Head SAR 0.1 W/kg
Scan Duration Scan for up to 30 minutes. Wait 10 minutes before the next imaging session.
Image Artifact The image artifact extends approximately 15 mm from the device.
Testing used a maximum gradient amplitude of 40 mT/m.
